sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Camera-ready season for Not All Instructions Are Forgotten Equal (JAIIO 2026). The reviewers asked for two things: baselines for every model, and a test of whether negation phrasing is what makes one instruction type degrade. Both experiments are running now; the benchmark goes public as an Inspect AI eval when they finish.

sections.heading: Writing
sections.body: I wrote a short story, La amenaza del Golem: a golem in Chełm follows every order to the letter and grows past the rabbi who made it. The same instruction-following problem I study at work, in 16th-century clothes.

sections.heading: Learning
sections.body: Starting BlueDot's Technical AI Safety Projects Sprint.
